caption: Opening film: a real humanoid running HOIST pushes a hanging box toward its target.
description: A real Unitree G1 humanoid running HOIST faces a gray box hanging from straps above a wooden platform with an outlined target. As the box comes down, the robot reaches forward and pushes it with its hands, then the box reaches the platform. Fully autonomous, at original speed, without audio. The sharp center of the frame is the HOIST panel from the authors' comparison recording; the sides are a blurred copy of the same picture.
source: The authors' supplementary hoist.mp4, 23–45 seconds, HOIST panel only.
changes: Excerpted, placed over a blurred copy of itself to fill a wide screen, resized, and H.264 compressed. Original playback speed; no audio.
